{{Top|leg}}
'''''Switch''''' was a pair of civilian [[Modular conveyor]]s. The transports were carrying supplies to an unknown location and were passing through [[Navigation buoy/Legends|Navigation buoys]] [[B-52]] and [[B-53]]. The ships were inspected by a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] and were allowed to pass on without incident, while [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] starfighters attempted to interfere with the TIE Defender's task of inspecting and disabling [[Cargo ferry]] [[Juble 2]].
